# bayesian-examples

The canonical Bayesian examples as methods a page or a worker runs by name and a few knobs: each rebuilds its data and model from the knobs (a model-bound inference method closes over its data, so the configuration is all that crosses a Worker boundary), takes one inference method from a table with its own knobs and a time budget, and reads the posterior at any step of the run through derived paths of its contract. So far Bayesian classification of a two-dimensional data set (probit or logistic, polynomial features).

- estimator `classifier-method.ts` (file): Bayesian probit or logistic classifier on 2-D data: one chosen inference method with its knobs. `src/lib/bayesian-examples/classifier-method.ts:1` `omai-engine/bayesian-examples`

- estimator `classifierMethod`: Bayesian classifier method: data, link, degree, prior, one inference method as knobs. `src/lib/bayesian-examples/classifier-method.ts:711` `omai-engine/bayesian-examples`
